title: GM TechLink: Ultium Battery System Powers the GMC HUMMER EV Pickup (2022-04-14)
notes: 24-module system with "approximately 200 kWh of available energy"; about 400 V per layer, layers in parallel normally and in series for "800-volt DC fast charging" (up to 800 V/350 kW); apps can precondition the battery for charging.
